text: Learning a new skill takes time and effort. First, you need regular practice. Even twenty minutes a day helps you improve. Patience is also important, because progress is often slow at the beginning. There are many resources you can use, such as online videos, books, or apps. It is useful to track your progress, for example by writing in a diary or taking photos. This way, you can see how much you have improved. Finally, motivation matters. Set small goals and celebrate your successes. Remember that everyone makes mistakes, and that is a normal part of learning.
